trailhead.label: Just above the Forte Basso di Col Vidal, Pian dei Buoi (official start)

cautions: Mountain path (CAI grade E) and old military tracks at about 1,800 m.
The First World War tunnels of the “Cinque Imbocchi” are unsafe: the official sheet advises visiting only their entrances, so keep your dog out.
The Strada del Genio to the start is narrow, with alternating traffic in July and August.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
